items.title: Why reviewing AI-generated code is devilishly hard
items.raw_excerpt: Hereâs the thing: when working on code with GenAI assistance (from a chat-bot, through IDE auto-completion, or, increasingly, with an AI agent) you need a better understanding of the system than when working without. Cognitive psychology and the workings of large language models (LLMs) give us four clues on why this happens.

title_i18n.en: Why reviewing AI-generated code is devilishly hard
title_i18n.zh: 审查AI生成的代码为何极其困难

excerpt_i18n.en: Hereâs the thing: when working on code with GenAI assistance (from a chat-bot, through IDE auto-completion, or, increasingly, with an AI agent) you need a better understanding of the system than when working without. title_i18n.zh: 约束衰减：大语言模型在后端代码生成中的脆弱性
title_i18n.es: Decaimiento de restricciones: La fragilidad de los agentes LLM en la generación de código de back-end

excerpt_i18n.en: A new study reveals the fragility of LLM agents in backend code generation, showing that code quality degrades significantly as constraints increase, a phenomenon termed 'constraint decay.' This finding serves as a caution for developers relying on LLMs for automated programming.
